title: “SciFest”-Science Fiesta for School Children’s from 7th to 12th Standard
content:
“SciFest”-Science Fiesta for School Children’s from 7th to 12th Standard

Government of India Ministry of Science and Technology

Department of Science and Technology

Project Title: “SciFest”-Science Fiesta for School Children from 7th to 12th Standard  
  • Project Cost:  Rs.17,90,800/-
  • Target Area/Place of activity: The events are planned to target the school children of  7th to 12th Standard from Chamarajanar, Mandya, Mysore, and Coorg Districts of Karnataka state, India.
  • Duration of the Project: 1 year
  • Activity/Events Proposed:
  • Hackathon
  • Poster Presentation
  • JAM Competition
  • Technical Project Exhibition
  • Science Quiz Competition
  • Essay Writing Competition
 
  • Beneficiaries: 800+ Participants
  Principal Investigator: Dr. Yathisha L Associate Professor Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering ATME College of Engineering   Co-Investigator: Mr. Guruprasad K N Associate Professor Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering ATME College of Engineering
